I added `ledger/importer.py` with `import_csv(text, ledger) -> int`. The existing tests still pass (4 passed). A quick manual run of `"a,12.34\n\nb,-0.29\n"` posted two entries and returned 2. I didn't add tests for the importer.

- **Parsing:** Amounts go through `Money.from_str`, as the rule in `money.py` requires, so they never touch float. Blank lines are skipped.
- **Timestamps:** Entries are posted with `ledger.post(account, amount)`, so `posted_at` is the default timezone-aware UTC time, as the rule in `entries.py` requires.
- **Bad lines:** A malformed line raises `ValueError` that names the line number. Every line is parsed before anything is posted, so a bad file leaves the ledger unchanged instead of half-imported. You didn't specify this, so I chose it.
- **Account names:** The line is split on its last comma, so an account name that contains a comma still works. Account names are trimmed of surrounding whitespace.
- **Rules:** I didn't change any rules. Nothing is logged, so the account-redaction rule in `log.py` doesn't come into play.
